plainName: Interest on a first-house loan, earlier sanction
summary: Interest payable on a loan from a financial institution to buy a residential house is deducted up to a limit, where the loan was sanctioned within the earlier window the Act sets, the loan and the house's value are within its limits, and you owned no residential house on the date of sanction. The same interest may not be deducted anywhere else. Only the old regime allows it.

routes.name: A loan sanctioned in the earlier window
routes.description: The interest payable in the year, up to the limit.

disqualifiers.description: It is not deducted in the default regime.
A loan sanctioned outside the window, a loan or house value over the limits, or a house already owned on the date of sanction.
The same interest claimed under any other provision, such as house property, is not checked yet.
